intro: Two carriers, three loci each. One schedules for fairness among runnable loci; the other for admitted transitions.

steps.caption: Place the loci. Each carrier is about to run flat out.
Both run. Utilization: 100 % and 100 %. By the conventional measure they are equally healthy.
Now look at what was admitted. A spent most of its commands relocating loci for fairness. B admitted transitions.
steps.takeaway: The busiest Carrier can be the one making the least progress — the title of R7-EXECUTED.

steps.caption: Later: B is 70 % utilized and further ahead. Utilization went down; progress went up.
steps.takeaway: Health is admitted semantic transitions per unit cost, never carrier busyness.

steps.caption: What this picture cannot tell you is the number. The receipt on this page can, and the model document it came from says of itself: never a measurement.
steps.takeaway: Busywork Scheduling is the anti-pattern: maximizing utilization while semantic progress stalls.
